thread:
matt_garcia: kickoff: publishing ts/python SDKs shortly. doing canary for JS and staged for Py. will push dist-tag after smoke.
rachel_choi: great — what's the plan for dist-tags & deprecation notes?
matt_garcia: JS -> canary, then promote to latest if green. Py -> 0.10.0-beta on PyPI, not GA. deprecation paragraph for sync client included in release notes.
deploy-bot: INFO: publish job queued. performing dry-run.
ci-bot: dry-run logs: npm pack ok, twine check ok. Warning: PYPI_TOKEN expires in 4 days (user rachel_choi). Recommend rotate before GA.
leo_khan: hmm rotate now? we can proceed for canary but need rotation before final. Rachel, can you rotate and update Secrets Manager?
rachel_choi: on it. I'll create scoped token and set rotation policy to 7d. updating repo secret now.
matt_garcia: I'll start npm publish --tag canary first, then twine upload to test PyPI endpoint, then final twine to prod after token rotation.
ci-bot: npm publish succeeded: @redwood/sdk-js v1.9.0-canary. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/1759876543/npm
ci-bot: twine upload to test.pypi succeeded for redwood-sdk-python v0.10.0-beta. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/1759876543/pypi-test
leo_khan: smoke installs passing on node 18/20 and python 3.10/3.11 in staging containers.
matt_garcia: enabling telemetry flags and canary routing for internal apps. keep an eye on signer-helper test.
ci-bot: flaky: signer-helper integration failed once in a staging job. recording occurrence.
ops-bot: routing note: canary traffic split 5% for 1 hour to shadow pool. Will increase if stable.
rachel_choi: token rotated, secret updated, verified upload with a small test package to PyPI.
leo_khan: quick heads-up: a transitive dep bumped to 2.5.1 yesterday — might explain signer-helper flake. Opening PR to pin to 2.5.0.
matt_garcia: rollback criteria: >2 failures in 30m OR errors >0.8% for install/import in telemetry. If hit, remove npm canary tag and publish fix branch. For PyPI, mark deprecated and publish hotfix beta.
ci-bot: alert: signer-helper failed 2x within 12m on canary consumers.
deploy-bot: monitor:30m tag set. If another regression detected, will execute dist-tag remove.
rachel_choi: creating deprecation blurb for legacy sync client and adding to release notes. linking doc: https://docs.internal/releases/sdk-1.9.0-canary-draft.md
leo_khan: PR #4523 created to pin transitive dep. Requesting urgent review from infra.
matt_garcia: agreed — hold GA until 30m passes and PR lands. If PR is merged and pipeline green, we'll re-run canary with pinned dep and then promote.
ops-bot: scheduled rollback playbook ready: remove canary tag, revert publish commit, update release-tracker, and notify customers via status page draft.
ci-bot: re-run smoke on pinned branch queued.
leo_khan: tests passing on pinned branch locally. pushing CI run.
matt_garcia: thanks team. current status: canary/staged published; PyPI token rotated; monitoring window active (30m). Will update thread at 10m and at end of window or earlier if we hit thresholds. :rocket:
